name: Elicit
tagline: AI research assistant for systematic literature review
description: Elicit is an AI research assistant that automates time-consuming parts of systematic literature review. It searches across 200+ million research papers, extracts specific data points from PDFs, synthesises findings across papers, and generates structured evidence tables. Elicit is designed for scientific rigour — it cites specific papers for every claim and shows its reasoning. Used extensively by medical researchers, policy analysts, and PhD students.
pricingDetails: Free: basic search, 5 full-text analyses/month. Plus: $10/month. Enterprise: custom.
